description: The two pie charts represent the distribution of different categories in two separate datasets. Each chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to "Atomic Skill Fail", "Correct", "Reason Error", and "Question Misunderstood". The left chart has slices labeled with their respective percentages: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark blue, 8.0%), "Correct" (teal, 68.0%), "Reason Error" (light blue, 12.0%), and "Question Misunderstood" (gray, 12.0%). The right chart also has four slices with percentage labels: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark blue, 10.0%), "Correct" (teal, 55.0%), "Reason Error" (light blue, 21.0%), and "Question Misunderstood" (gray, 14.0%). A legend is provided above the charts, indicating the color associated with each category. The slices in both charts are visually distinct due to their different colors, and the percentages are displayed inside each slice. The charts do not appear to have any visually emphasized slices. The slices are not ordered in a particular way.
